testEffect: Weakening `expect(subtotal(items)).toBe(25)` to `expect(subtotal(items)).toBeTruthy()` would accept any non-zero result from `subtotal`, not only the correct sum.
productionEffect: Corrupting `subtotal` to sum only price while ignoring `qty` (returning 15 instead of 25 for this cart) is expected to fail this test as written; applying the weaker `toBeTruthy()` assertion described above to that same corrupted `subtotal` would instead let it keep passing, showing the exact-value assertion is what actually catches the regression.
